alt: Official Email Correspondence Page 1 — Senator Suzette Valladares' Office (Sydney Hill)
summary: Email correspondence from Constituent Services Representative Sydney Hill of Senator Suzette Valladares' office, confirming the initiation of a formal casework inquiry to DHCS regarding the Conlan reimbursement default and the State Fair Hearing default (SHN-[REDACTED]96). Establishes the Senator's office acted in good faith and was responsive, and that any delays are entirely due to DHCS's non-responsiveness.
full_text: Correspondence from Sydney Hill, Constituent Services Representative for California State Senator Suzette Valladares (District 23). Confirming that the Senator's office is actively working on the casework file, has initiated a formal legislative inquiry to the Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) liaison, and is waiting for DHCS to provide an update regarding the Conlan reimbursement and State Hearing status.
